title: The Cleaner in the Ivory Dress
style: Photorealistic cinematic drama still set in contemporary Lagos, 50mm lens look with shallow depth of field, rich natural skin tones, warm golden highlights with deep teal shadows, polished high-end film atmosphere

characters.name: Adaeze
characters.anchor: Nigerian woman in her mid-twenties, deep brown skin with a warm undertone, oval face with high cheekbones, large dark-brown almond eyes, soft rounded nose, full lips, natural black hair pulled into a low neat bun with a centre parting, long neck, slim build, average height, a small beauty mark beside the left eyebrow

wardrobe.label: Cleaner uniform

wardrobe.label: Ivory gown

locations.name: Gala ballroom
locations.anchor: Grand hotel ballroom with a sweeping white marble staircase and gold balustrade at one end, three tiered crystal chandeliers, cream walls with gilded mouldings, round tables in ivory linen with tall white floral centrepieces, a polished dark wood floor

locations.name: Ballroom corridor
locations.anchor: Quiet side corridor beside a hotel ballroom, cream panelled walls, burgundy carpet with a gold border, brass wall sconces, a tall arched window with heavy gold drapes, a marble console table holding a large vase of white lilies

locations.name: Vivienne's bedroom
locations.anchor: Very large modern master bedroom, king bed with a tufted cream velvet headboard and white linen, floor-to-ceiling windows with sheer curtains, a mirrored wardrobe wall, pale marble floor, a gold-framed vanity table crowded with perfume bottles and jewellery boxes

locations.name: Vivienne's living room
locations.anchor: Opulent double-height living room, white marble floor, curved cream sofas, a glass coffee table with gold legs, an oversized abstract painting in gold and black, a crystal chandelier, tall arched windows, a long glossy dark dining table at the far end

locations.name: Vivienne's kitchen
locations.anchor: Large glossy modern kitchen, white handleless cabinets, a black marble island with three gold bar stools, built-in steel ovens, a steel water dispenser beside the fridge, glass pendant lights, grey tiled floor

locations.name: Vivienne's bathroom
locations.anchor: Spacious luxury bathroom, white marble with grey veins on the walls and floor, a freestanding oval bathtub, a double vanity with gold taps and a wide backlit mirror, a glass walk-in shower, a blue plastic bucket and scrubbing brush on the floor

locations.name: Adaeze's small room
locations.anchor: Small single room in a modest Lagos compound, pale green walls with peeling patches, a thin mattress on a low wooden frame with a faded floral sheet, one louvre window with a blue curtain, a small wooden table and stool, a cracked mirror on a nail, bare cement floor

locations.name: Compound yard
locations.anchor: Modest single-storey Lagos compound, a row of rooms under a rusted corrugated roof, cream walls stained at the base, blue wooden doors, a concrete yard with a water tap and plastic buckets, a clothes line, a narrow metal gate onto an untarred street

locations.name: Eze family sitting room
locations.anchor: Elegant sitting room in a large family home, high ceiling, cream walls hung with framed fashion sketches, deep teal velvet sofas, a carved dark-wood coffee table, brass floor lamps, a handwoven patterned rug, tall French windows onto a garden and driveway

locations.name: Zara's atelier
locations.anchor: Spacious fashion atelier, white brick walls, long oak cutting tables covered with pattern paper and scissors, rows of dress forms, shelves of fabric bolts in every colour, industrial sewing machines beside tall factory windows, a pinboard wall of sketches, polished concrete floor

locations.name: Zara's first room
locations.anchor: Tiny bare room from decades ago, unpainted cement walls, one small window with a wooden shutter, a black manual treadle sewing machine on a scarred wooden table, a wooden stool, a single hanging bulb, fabric scraps piled in a raffia basket

locations.name: Runway hall
locations.anchor: Large modern event hall set for a fashion show, a long raised white runway down the centre, rows of gold chiavari chairs on both sides, black draped walls, a heavy white backstage curtain at the far end, a ceiling rig of warm spotlights

locations.name: Show foyer
locations.anchor: Bright modern foyer of an event venue, glass entrance doors, pale stone floor, a long cream carpet leading inside, tall arrangements of white orchids, brass posts with ivory ropes, recessed ceiling lights

locations.name: Residential street
locations.anchor: Quiet residential Lagos street, cracked tarmac with sandy edges, high cream compound walls topped with wire, black iron gates, a mango tree overhanging one wall, a parked dark saloon car, tangled overhead power lines

locations.name: Training centre
locations.anchor: Plain community training room, pale yellow walls, rows of wooden desks each holding a manual sewing machine, a chalkboard, ceiling fans, louvre windows, shelves of folded ankara fabric and thread cones, worn linoleum floor

scenes.lighting: clear mid-morning light
scenes.motion: The door swings open and the two women look at each other, camera holds from the yard

scenes.action: Over Adaeze's shoulder, Vivienne sits on the wooden stool looking slowly around the small room
scenes.lighting: soft morning light through the blue curtain
scenes.motion: Vivienne's eyes travel over the walls and the mattress, camera holds

scenes.action: Adaeze sits upright on the edge of the mattress with her hands in her lap, speaking gently
scenes.lighting: soft morning light through the blue curtain
scenes.motion: She speaks and smiles faintly, camera moves in slowly

scenes.action: Vivienne leans forward on the stool wringing her hands as she talks to Adaeze
scenes.lighting: soft morning light through the blue curtain
scenes.motion: Vivienne twists her fingers and looks up, camera eases toward her

scenes.action: Over Adaeze's shoulder, Vivienne stands at the doorway and lifts a hand in a quiet goodbye
scenes.lighting: clear mid-morning light
scenes.motion: Vivienne nods, turns and walks across the yard, camera stays with Adaeze

scenes.action: Adaeze pauses at the compound gate with her travel bag for one last look back at the row of rooms while Vivienne waits beside a car
scenes.lighting: clear mid-morning light
scenes.motion: Adaeze looks back, then turns toward the gate, camera rises slowly over the yard

scenes.action: Zara wraps Adaeze in a tight embrace in the middle of the sitting room, a travel bag dropped at their feet
scenes.lighting: warm afternoon light through the French windows
scenes.motion: Zara rocks her daughter gently, camera circles slowly around them

scenes.action: Zara and Adaeze walk slowly between the rows of dress forms, Adaeze trailing her fingers along a bolt of fabric
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: They walk side by side, camera glides backward ahead of them

scenes.action: Over Zara's shoulder, Adaeze sits across the cutting table speaking with her hands open
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: Adaeze gestures as she speaks, camera holds behind Zara

scenes.action: Grace walks alone along the quiet street before sunrise with a small bag on her shoulder
scenes.lighting: blue pre-dawn light with one glowing street lamp
scenes.motion: Grace walks toward the camera, which retreats slowly

scenes.action: Emeka sits behind the wheel of the parked car, watching the street through the windscreen
scenes.lighting: flat grey afternoon light
scenes.motion: He drums a finger on the wheel and waits, camera holds through the windscreen

scenes.action: Adaeze's hand smooths a bolt of deep navy fabric unrolled across the cutting table
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: Her palm glides over the cloth, camera follows the hand

scenes.action: Comfort walks hand in hand with a small child in a school uniform beside the cream compound wall
scenes.lighting: soft early-morning light
scenes.motion: They walk slowly and Comfort looks down at the child, camera tracks beside them

scenes.action: Adaeze stands between Zara and Sade at the pinboard wall, pointing to an empty space among the sketches
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: Adaeze points and turns to them, camera pushes in slowly

scenes.action: Adaeze's pencil draws the first clean line of a dress on a blank sketchbook page
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: The pencil moves in one long confident stroke, camera follows the line

scenes.action: Adaeze pins a finished sketch to the centre of the pinboard while Zara watches with her arms folded
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: Adaeze presses the pin in and steps back, camera holds on both women

scenes.action: Over Adaeze's shoulder, a young woman in a cleaner's tunic and a middle-aged man in a driver's shirt sit across the cutting table as she writes in a notebook
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: The two workers speak in turn as Adaeze writes, camera holds

scenes.action: Grace, Emeka and Comfort stand hesitantly just inside the atelier doorway as Adaeze walks toward them with her hand extended and Zara looks on
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: Adaeze crosses the floor and shakes each hand, camera follows her

scenes.action: Grace sits with her worn hands folded on the table, speaking softly
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: Grace looks down at her hands then up, camera moves in slowly

scenes.action: Emeka sits at the table with his car keys resting in front of him, speaking with a faint tired smile
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: Emeka turns the keys over once as he talks, camera holds

scenes.action: Comfort touches the small silver locket at her neck as she speaks
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: Her fingers close around the locket, camera pushes in

scenes.action: Over Adaeze's shoulder, she sketches a dress with clean straight lines while Zara points at the page
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: The pencil moves as Zara's finger traces a line, camera holds on the page

scenes.action: A seamstress's hands stitch tiny glass beads onto the crisp white collar of a pale blue dress on a dress form
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: Needle and thread pull a bead tight, camera moves along the collar

scenes.action: Zara opens a tailored jacket to show Adaeze the lining embroidered with tiny golden handprints
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: Zara lifts the jacket front and Adaeze leans in, camera eases closer

scenes.action: Comfort runs her fingertips over the golden handprints inside the jacket as Adaeze holds it open for her
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: Comfort traces one small handprint, camera holds on her face and hand

scenes.action: A flowing gown in warm saffron and terracotta fabric hangs on a dress form as Adaeze drapes its skirt for Zara
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: The skirt settles into soft folds, camera circles the dress form

scenes.action: A sharply tailored deep navy coat-dress with clean lines and brass buttons stands on a dress form by the factory windows
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: Light slides across the brass buttons, camera rises slowly up the garment

scenes.action: Adaeze shows Sade a handwritten list in a ledger on the cutting table, tapping the page
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: Adaeze taps the list and Sade nods, camera holds

scenes.action: Late at night, seamstresses work at the sewing machines while Adaeze and Zara check a garment together
scenes.lighting: night, warm work lamps against dark windows
scenes.motion: Machines hum and hands guide fabric, camera drifts down the row of tables

scenes.action: Over Zara's shoulder, Adaeze marks the front row on a seating plan spread across the table
scenes.lighting: night, warm work lamps against dark windows
scenes.motion: Adaeze circles the front row with a pencil, camera holds on the plan

scenes.action: Grace stands at a black iron gate holding an ivory envelope tied with a gold ribbon in both hands
scenes.lighting: warm late-afternoon light
scenes.motion: Grace looks from the envelope up to the sky and smiles, camera pushes in

scenes.action: Elegant guests stream through the glass doors and along the cream carpet past the white orchids
scenes.lighting: evening, bright warm recessed lighting
scenes.motion: Guests walk in chatting, camera glides forward with them

scenes.action: Ivory ribbons are tied to the gold front-row chairs beside the white runway, with framed portraits of workers on the black wall behind
scenes.lighting: house lights half up, warm and quiet before the show
scenes.motion: A ribbon stirs slightly, camera moves along the row of chairs

scenes.action: Grace, Emeka and Comfort stand before the ribboned front-row chairs looking at one another in disbelief
scenes.lighting: house lights half up, warm and quiet before the show
scenes.motion: Comfort touches a ribbon and they slowly sit, camera eases in

scenes.action: Over Emeka's shoulder, Adaeze greets Grace at the front row and clasps her hand
scenes.lighting: house lights half up, warm and quiet before the show
scenes.motion: Adaeze bends to greet them, camera holds behind Emeka

scenes.action: Grace sits in the front row with one hand pressed to her chest
scenes.lighting: house lights half up, warm and quiet before the show
scenes.motion: Grace breathes in and blinks back tears, camera moves in slowly

scenes.action: A model walks out on the runway in a refined pale blue dress with a beaded white collar as Grace watches from the front row
scenes.lighting: house lights dimmed, warm white spotlights on the runway
scenes.motion: The model walks toward the camera as heads turn, camera retreats along the runway

scenes.action: Tears run down Grace's cheeks as Emeka rests a hand on her shoulder
scenes.lighting: house lights dimmed, warm white spotlights on the runway
scenes.motion: Grace presses her fingers to her lips, camera holds close

scenes.action: A model at the end of the runway turns and opens her tailored jacket to reveal a lining of tiny golden handprints catching the light
scenes.lighting: house lights dimmed, warm white spotlights on the runway
scenes.motion: The model turns and the lining flashes gold, camera pushes in on the lining

scenes.action: Over Emeka's shoulder, a model in the sharp navy coat-dress strides past as he straightens in his front-row seat
scenes.lighting: house lights dimmed, warm white spotlights on the runway
scenes.motion: The model passes and Emeka lifts his chin, camera holds behind him

scenes.action: Adaeze and Zara stand before the wall of framed worker portraits, Adaeze pointing to one of an elderly driver
scenes.lighting: house lights dimmed, warm white spotlights on the runway
scenes.motion: Adaeze points and Zara nods slowly, camera slides along the portraits

scenes.action: Grace, Emeka and Comfort stand together under a spotlight as the audience applauds them
scenes.lighting: house lights dimmed, warm white spotlights on the runway
scenes.motion: The audience claps and the three clasp hands, camera rises slowly

scenes.action: Grace stands before a large framed portrait of herself as Adaeze gestures toward it
scenes.lighting: house lights dimmed, warm white spotlights on the runway
scenes.motion: Grace steps closer to the portrait, camera eases in behind her

scenes.action: Comfort gazes at her own framed portrait with her fingers closed around her silver locket
scenes.lighting: house lights dimmed, warm white spotlights on the runway
scenes.motion: Her grip tightens on the locket, camera holds on her face

scenes.action: Emeka stands tall before his framed portrait as Adaeze rests a hand on his arm
scenes.lighting: house lights dimmed, warm white spotlights on the runway
scenes.motion: Emeka nods slowly at his portrait, camera drifts sideways

scenes.action: Behind the white backstage curtain, Zara holds Adaeze's face in her hands as light from the runway spills through the gap
scenes.lighting: house lights dimmed, warm white spotlights on the runway
scenes.motion: Zara brushes a tear from her daughter's cheek, camera moves in gently

scenes.action: The workers in the front row rise to their feet as the final model passes in a sweeping gown and the audience applauds them
scenes.lighting: house lights dimmed, warm white spotlights on the runway
scenes.motion: The whole room stands and claps, camera sweeps down the runway

scenes.action: Adaeze wipes a tear from her cheek at the side of the runway with Zara's arm around her shoulders
scenes.lighting: house lights dimmed, warm white spotlights on the runway
scenes.motion: Adaeze laughs softly through tears, camera holds

scenes.action: Adaeze kneels alone scrubbing the marble bathroom floor, seen through the half-open door
scenes.lighting: cool pale early-morning light
scenes.motion: She scrubs slowly, camera pulls back through the doorway

scenes.action: Adaeze stands beside a displayed garment speaking with two admiring guests
scenes.lighting: house lights up, warm and bright after the show
scenes.motion: Adaeze gestures to the garment as the guests nod, camera eases in

scenes.action: Grace pulls Adaeze into a motherly hug
scenes.lighting: house lights up, warm and bright after the show
scenes.motion: Grace pats Adaeze's back, camera holds close

scenes.action: Adaeze holds both of Comfort's hands as they smile at each other
scenes.lighting: house lights up, warm and bright after the show
scenes.motion: Comfort laughs and squeezes her hands, camera drifts around them

scenes.action: Over Adaeze's shoulder, Emeka shakes her hand with both of his, standing very straight
scenes.lighting: house lights up, warm and bright after the show
scenes.motion: Emeka bows his head slightly as they shake hands, camera holds

scenes.action: A framed black-and-white portrait of an elderly housekeeper with kind eyes hangs on the black wall under a small spotlight
scenes.lighting: house lights up, warm and bright after the show
scenes.motion: The spotlight glows on the glass, camera moves in slowly

scenes.action: Vivienne stands with Adaeze near the end of the runway, holding her handbag in front of her with both hands
scenes.lighting: house lights up, warm and bright after the show
scenes.motion: Vivienne shifts her grip on the bag as she speaks, camera eases in

scenes.action: Adaeze answers with a calm open expression, the empty runway blurred behind her
scenes.lighting: house lights up, warm and bright after the show
scenes.motion: She speaks slowly and evenly, camera pushes in a little

scenes.action: Vivienne crouches beside a young woman at a sewing machine, awkwardly helping her guide the fabric
scenes.lighting: plain flat daylight through louvre windows
scenes.motion: Vivienne steadies the cloth as the needle runs, camera tracks slowly along the desks

scenes.action: Over Vivienne's shoulder, Adaeze speaks to her gently but firmly
scenes.lighting: house lights up, warm and bright after the show
scenes.motion: Adaeze nods once as she speaks, camera holds behind Vivienne

scenes.action: Vivienne clasps Adaeze's hand in both of her own
scenes.lighting: house lights up, warm and bright after the show
scenes.motion: Vivienne's hands tighten then release, camera holds on the hands

scenes.action: Vivienne walks alone toward the glass doors of the foyer and glances back once
scenes.lighting: late night, soft warm recessed lighting
scenes.motion: Vivienne walks away and looks back over her shoulder, camera stays still

scenes.action: Adaeze and Zara wave goodbye as Grace, Emeka and Comfort leave together carrying small ivory gift bags
scenes.lighting: house lights up, warm and bright after the show
scenes.motion: The three workers turn and wave back, camera pulls back slowly

scenes.action: Zara and Adaeze stand arm in arm looking over the empty runway and the rows of chairs
scenes.lighting: most lights off, one soft spotlight left on the runway
scenes.motion: They stand still as the last lights dim, camera rises slowly above them

acts.title: Act 12: The Girl Who Came Back

scenes.action: Zara sinks onto the teal sofa as Adaeze kneels to slip off her mother's shoes
scenes.lighting: late night, low warm lamp light
scenes.motion: Zara leans back and closes her eyes, camera eases in

scenes.action: Adaeze lifts a new pencil sketch of a gown from the cutting table, a line of handwriting at its corner
scenes.lighting: night, a single desk lamp
scenes.motion: She lifts the page into the lamp light, camera moves in on the sketch

scenes.action: Adaeze stands at the French windows looking out at a row of polished cars on the drive
scenes.lighting: warm afternoon light through the French windows
scenes.motion: She rests a hand on the window frame, camera pushes in slowly from behind

scenes.action: Adaeze sits on the thin mattress rubbing her aching bare feet
scenes.lighting: dim warm light from a single bulb, night
scenes.motion: She kneads one foot and exhales, camera holds

scenes.action: The ivory beaded gown and the grey cleaner's uniform hang side by side on a clothes rail
scenes.lighting: night, a single desk lamp
scenes.motion: Both garments sway very slightly, camera moves slowly from one to the other

scenes.action: Adaeze holds the sketch against her chest with her eyes lifted
scenes.lighting: night, a single desk lamp
scenes.motion: She closes her eyes and smiles, camera moves in gently

scenes.action: Adaeze hands a glass of water to an elderly housekeeper and gestures for her to sit on the teal sofa
scenes.lighting: soft morning light through the French windows
scenes.motion: The housekeeper accepts the glass with a surprised smile, camera drifts around them

scenes.action: Adaeze stands at the tall factory windows at sunrise with a soft smile
scenes.lighting: sunrise, soft gold light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: Sunlight rises across her face, camera holds

scenes.action: The ivory beaded gown stands on a dress form in the centre of the quiet atelier
scenes.lighting: sunrise, soft gold light through tall factory windows
scenes.motion: Morning light spreads across the floor, camera pulls back slowly
